messages:
amanda: FYI I opened a tiny PR to merge the Dedicated onboarding playbook into the handbook. Mostly samples + a new checklist for tenant migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook/pull/427

diego: Saw it. Quick nit: the autoscale cooldown section doesn't mention preemption behavior. Should we add a short paragraph and link to eviction docs?

amanda: Good catch. Also we need a small SDK snippet for Python that shows setting the scale_policy with min/max. @tasha — can you add?

tasha: Yep, can do. Thinking of two snippets: terraform example for reserved pools + python SDK usage. Will push both as separate commits.

docs-bot: Broken link detected in PR: /handbook/dedicated/old-eviction -> 404. Suggest replacement: /handbook/dedicated/preemption-behavior

raj: SLA owners: sres — do we want to state the 99.9% latency SLO for reserved vs shared? current wording is ambiguous.

sre-ops: 99.9% is for Reserved Capacity only. Shared/hosted is best-effort. I'll add exact phrasing and the recovery window (5m) in a followup.

diego: Can we clarify isolation decorators: example labels and whether tenant-level labels are required. current snippet looks permissive.

tasha: pushed commit with snippets. Terraform snippet (simple example):
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "ml" {
  name = "tenant-ml-pool"
  gpu_type = "a10g"
  capacity = 4
  preemption_policy = "fallback"
}
```
Also python SDK example in PR.

amanda: Thanks! also add a migration note: if you were using 'reserved' v1 api, the tenant label key changed from `owner` to `tenant_id`. Add CLI command to patch tenants.

tasha: Added migration note + one-liner CLI:
```bash
rwctl tenant patch --from-owner --to-tenant_id
```
PTAL @diego @sre-ops

diego: LGTM aside from one grammar nit. also update link in nav to point to new playbook path.

amanda: :thumbsup: I'll merge after docs-bot confirms no broken links and CI passes.

docs-bot: Link-checker: 0 broken links. Build: passed (staging).

raj: Can we also include a short QA checklist for oncall to run after provisioning? e.g., validate responder, run `rwctl capacity status`

amanda: Good idea — added QA checklist at bottom. Marking this thread resolved. Thanks team.
